lines: Utilitarianism is thě most important and influential secular ethic
of modern times, but also the most controversial, becauseit
seems to undermine conventional moral views.
This Very Short Introduction provides an authoritative
account of the origins of utilitarianism, the main objections
to it, and how it can be justified and defended. Utilitarianism
remains a force for new thinking on contemporary ethical
challenges like global poverty, the treatment of animals,
the right to die, and climate change.
Katarzyna de Lazari-Radek is an assistant professor at
the University of Lodz, and co-author, with Peter Singer,
of The Point of View of the Universe: Sidgwick and
Contemporary Ethics (2016).
Peter Singer is the lra W. DeCamp Professor of Bioethics
at Princeton University and author of Practical Ethics
(3rd edn, 2011) and Ethics in the Real World (2016),
among other books.
VERY SHORT INTRODUCTIONS
Brilliant. Sharp. Inspiring.
